title: Weekly financial statements
summary: This is an ECB webpage describing the publication schedule for the Eurosystem's weekly financial statements, which are published on Tuesdays relating to the preceding Friday. The page outlines exceptions to the standard publication day (e.g., first financial statement of each quarter published Wednesdays) and provides the 2026 publication calendar with special dates.
key_points: Weekly financial statements of the Eurosystem are published on Tuesdays, relating to the preceding Friday
First financial statement of each quarter is published on Wednesday instead of Tuesday to allow time for quarterly revaluation
TARGET system closures make those days non-business days for financial reporting purposes
2026 exceptions include: Week 1 (7 January, Wednesday), Week 14 (9 April, Thursday for Easter Monday), Week 27 (8 July, Wednesday), Week 40 (7 October, Wednesday)
The page links to related content including consolidated weekly financial statement user guide, annual balance sheet, and asset purchase programmes (PEPP)
why_it_matters: This page is an administrative scheduling notice and does not contain actionable financial data or market intelligence. The actual weekly financial statements would contain balance sheet data relevant to ECB operations (PEPP, APP holdings), but this specific page only describes when those statements are published.
market_structure_context: While weekly financial statements themselves reflect ECB balance sheet operations relevant to market structure, this page is merely a publication schedule guide and does not contain any actual balance sheet figures or operational data.
